blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Heavy rains poured over this city on Thursday afternoon (October 8), flooding several low-lying roads. This situation prompted disaster officials to alert barangays prone to flooding and landslides. The sudden downpour came after a hot and humid morning, with floodwaters quickly rising in some areas as the rains intensified. In a subdivision in Barangay Sta. Cruz, floodwaters rose to above–ankle level in less than an hour, forcing motorists to slow down as they passed through the flooded road.
